governing_spec.section: Section B: Journal Consumer Isolation & Old-Writer Retirement

transactional_cas_writes.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: _tx_lock acquired for critical write operations; idempotency succeeded reservation happens prior to entry store CAS commit. Staged outbox and audit events are emitted before entry compare_and_set commit. In case of CAS retry, failure, or synthetic error, staged outbox and audit events are cleanly rolled back and idempotency resets to pending, preventing failed mutations from leaking into concurrent successful patches.

append_only_audit_with_diff.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: patch_entry computes changedFields, diff changes (before/after) and appends audit record bound to actor_id, user_id, and tenant_id before entry CAS commit. Audit failures abort transaction without committing entry.

durable_outbox_streaming.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: outbox record store initialized and populated on entry creation and updates with decision_journal.entry.* event types with explicit tenant_id, actor_id, and user_id scoping. Outbox errors abort mutation before entry CAS commit.

tenant_and_user_isolation.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: Unified fail-closed _is_entry_accessible policy across get_entry, list_entries, DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter detail/list, DomainDecisionJournalReaderPort detail/list, and InMemoryOperationsConsultationPort. Tenant-scoped records strictly require matching tenant; tenant-only queries without actor deny private records; unscoped queries deny tenant-scoped records; legacy records with authored principal deny mismatched actors; and unauthored legacy records require explicit include_unscoped_legacy=True.

caller_supplied_id_collision_rejection.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: create_entry raises DecisionJournalCollisionError when a supplied ID collides with another principal's or tenant's record. AgoraService binds create replay durably to principal and request hash, surviving new service instances.

controlled_legacy_migration.implementation: services/governance/migrations/journal_migration.py: JournalMigrationEngine verifies principal ownership (createdBy/actor_id/userId) and SHA-256 checksum parity before destination mutation or disposition. Unscoped destination collisions with mismatched author or content are strictly rejected as conflicts. Checkpoints are recorded durably with verified readback, and source records are only disposed after parity verification.

unscoped_legacy_isolation.implementation: Ordinary patch fails closed on unscoped legacy rows (missing scope cannot be claimed by tenant patch) pending governed migration; list_entries excludes legacy rows by default unless include_unscoped_legacy=True.

fresh_process_restart_parity.implementation: CoordinatingJsonGovernanceRecordStore uses POSIX file locking (fcntl.flock) and cache invalidation on get/list_all/put/insert_if_absent/compare_and_set/delete to guarantee that multiple long-lived store instances across processes and threads coordinate safely without cache clobbering or losing committed records.
